## [3.97.0] - 2026-10-15

### Features

- implement rescan functionality and improve basket synchronization
- print purchase orders with the reference Hebrew layout
- declare forecourt opening cash in POS (AION-71)
- add configurable payment method button size and height
- improve pump layouts and compact cards (AION-83)
- prompt before adding digital club membership

### Bug Fixes

- preserve Code 128 fallback for invalid EAN data
- preserve coupons on explicit history resend
- harden deferred benefit delivery

- prevent duplicate benefit delivery
- validate orders before storing benefits
- serialize deferred benefit recovery
- keep SMS independent of coupon printing
- reconcile deferred benefit delivery
- align frontend and addon versions

- schedule deferred prompt frame
- reuse register cash selectors for forecourt opening
- reserve barcode height before fitting captions
- recover deferred benefit delivery
- isolate desktop prompt retries
- bundle Hebrew-capable fonts for consistent raster output
- retain permanent initial rejection
- retain deferred receipt delivery

- scope delivery state by account

- clear delivery state on account reset
- recheck registration suppression
- defer queued membership coupon delivery
- prefer latest queued loyalty state
- retry live loyalty updates
- make benefit delivery durable
- close registration prompt races

### Other Changes

- pin merged forecourt opening API
- Revert "fix(receipts): keep benefit delivery alive during print"
- Keep product and cart flex positive during live layout resizing
- Show localized full tank limit on compact pump cards
- Localize pump authorization errors and retain recovery indicators
- Fix retained pump routing, controls, and production layouts
- assert mutation outcome classification
- run registration route race in CI
- validate dialog-based full tank authorization
- simplify customer action button layout
- Add localization for loyalty signup button in multiple languages
- Enhance Paytag processing to prevent event replay during payment and add corresponding tests
- Fix customer removal handling in automatic mutation provider and add corresponding test
- Add Paytag exchange and scan queue functionality with tests
